events.description: After a copy of the new-item template was added: fill in its content here.
events.name: ok:sortable:add

events.description: A move was cancelled (Escape, an interrupted touch), before the item goes back.
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; index: number; list: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:dragcancel

events.description: The item was dropped in this list, at `index`.
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; index: number; list: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:dragend

events.description: The item is about to move to `index` in `list` (this list or another one).
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; index: number; list: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:dragover

events.description: An item was grabbed (keyboard, tap) or started a pointer drag.
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; index: number; list: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:dragstart

events.description: Before an item moves from index `from` to `to`. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the order.
events.detail: { from: number; to: number; item: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:move

events.description: Before an item is removed. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it.
events.name: ok:sortable:remove

events.description: Before two items trade places (lists with `data-ok-strategy="swap"`): the item at `from` and `target` at `to`. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the order.
events.detail: { from: number; to: number; item: HTMLElement; target: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:swap

events.description: Before an item moves to another list of its group (`data-ok-group`), at `index` in `to`. Fires on the list it leaves. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it.
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; from: HTMLElement; to: HTMLElement; index: number; }
events.name: ok:sortable:transfer

methods.description: Appends a clone of `template[data-ok-sortable-template]`; returns it (or `null`).
methods.name: add

methods.description: Moves an item. Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:move` was prevented.
methods.name: move

methods.description: Removes an item. Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:remove` was prevented.
methods.name: remove

methods.description: Swaps two items (the `swap` strategy's move). Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:swap` was prevented.
methods.name: swap

methods.description: Moves the item at `index` to another sortable list (an element or its `id`), at `toIndex` (default: its end). Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:transfer` was prevented.
methods.name: transfer
methods.type: (index: number, to: string | HTMLElement, toIndex?: number | undefined) => boolean

options.description: Grid, one column or one scrolling row.
options.name: layout

options.description: While dragging near the edge of a scroll area or the window, it scrolls; `false` turns it off.
options.name: autoScroll

options.description: `sort` shifts the items between the old and the new position; `swap` trades the places of two items.
options.name: strategy

options.description: Where a pointer drag starts: the `handle`, or anywhere on the `item` (the handle stays for keys and taps).
options.name: activator

parts.description: On the list: the groups it takes items from, separated by spaces (default: its own group).
parts.name: data-ok-accept

parts.description: On an item: it can't move and isn't a target (its handle is `disabled` too).
parts.name: data-ok-disabled

parts.description: Set by the runtime on the item being dragged.
parts.name: data-ok-dragging

parts.description: Set by the runtime on the item grabbed with the keyboard.
parts.name: data-ok-grabbed

parts.description: On the list: the group it belongs to. Items move between lists of the same group.
parts.name: data-ok-group

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when a move is cancelled (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-cancelled

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when an item is dropped (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-dropped

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when an item is grabbed (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-grabbed

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when an item moves (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-moved

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when an item moves to this list (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-moved-to-list

parts.description: HTML: on the list, the announcement when an item is removed (`{position}`, `{total}`, `{list}`).
parts.name: data-ok-message-removed

parts.description: The buttons at the end of an item.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-actions

parts.description: HTML only: the button that adds a copy of the new-item template.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-add

parts.description: A visually hidden live region that announces moves. Created once per page.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-announcer

parts.description: The handle that drags an item, or moves it with the keyboard.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-handle

parts.description: On a button or menu item inside an item: the `id` of the list it moves the item to (its end).
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-move-to

parts.description: The button that removes its item.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-remove

parts.description: HTML only: the markup of new items.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-template

parts.description: Set by the runtime, swap lists: on the item the moved one would trade places with.
parts.name: data-ok-swap-target

react.description: A controlled list reordered by dragging the handle, by keyboard (Space, arrows, Escape) or by two taps. Name it with `aria-label`.

props.description: The groups this list takes items from (default: its own `group`). Set it to take items from other groups, such as a "Done" list that takes tasks but gives none back.
props.name: accept

props.description: Where a pointer drag starts: `"handle"`, or anywhere on the `"item"` except the controls in it. The handle stays for the keyboard and for taps.
props.name: activator

props.description: While dragging near the edge of a scroll area (such as a Scrollbar) or the window, it scrolls.
props.name: autoScroll

props.description: Name used in the handle / remove labels ("Reorder …", "Remove …").
props.name: getItemLabel

props.description: Stable identity of an item (React key).
props.name: getKey

props.description: Connects lists: items move between lists of the page with the same group (drag, keys, taps, move-to triggers). Give each list an `id`.
props.name: group

props.description: Items that can't move: their handle is disabled and other items don't take their place.
props.name: isItemDisabled

props.description: Grid, one column or one scrolling row.
props.name: layout

props.description: Called when a move is cancelled (Escape, an interrupted touch), before the item goes back.
props.name: onDragCancel

props.description: Called when the item is dropped in this list.
props.name: onDragEnd

props.description: Called before the item moves over another position, in this list or another one.
props.name: onDragOver

props.description: Called when an item is grabbed (keyboard, tap) or starts a pointer drag.
props.name: onDragStart

props.description: Renders a remove button per item and is called when one is pressed.
props.name: onRemove

props.description: Called with the reordered items (controlled: render them to apply the move).
props.name: onReorder

props.description: Called when an item of this list moves to another list. Update both lists, for example with `moveBetweenLists(lists, event)`. Without it, items never leave the list.
props.name: onTransfer

props.description: How a move rearranges the list: `"sort"` shifts the items between the old and the new position, `"swap"` trades the places of the moved item and the one it is dropped on (the others stay). `onReorder` gets the result either way.
props.name: strategy
